title: Live activity feature
body:
Hello dev team, wonderful app and UI/UX. One feature i am so much anticipating is “Live activity” for iPhone 14 Pro/Pro Max dynamic island. Whenever i set a timer for study, i want to exit app to the background and see my timer showing up on that island, it would make it so much better.

Great example use case: when i have a break timer and i wish to scroll my phone, i don’t need to go back to app to see how much time i have left, i could see it on my island. That would be amazing.

Thank you for amazing app already 😀

author: chaselooner

title: Controversial
body:
I wave a subscription for some time now.
App has nice UI, simple functionality covering basic habit tracking needs, with some nice features.

What I don’t like: Developer focusing a lot on changing or improving UI, occasionally introducing critical bugs like habits become duplicated or some habits don’t show up at all after app update.
I would rather see more stable app, better habit statistics, habit editing without loosing all starts.
My point: I would rather see less UI changes, but making essential functionality work better.
author: Denys U

title: Please stop adding unnecessary bells and whistles
body: I have been using the app for more than two years. In the beginning I liked ot a lot! But with each upgrade I am uneasy because I do not need more features yet they keep popping up and there is no way to get rid if them. First annoyance was the monthly fee - quite heavy as well. Fortunately the reminder to buy it does not show up anymore every time I complete habits for a day. But now I see Hooray message like I am 5 years old. Instead of seeing clearly the completed tasks count. Because of the continual “improvements” (size is over 100MG now!) I actually want to leave the app and the only thing that keeps me is the almost three years of history.
author: kyuzo.

title: Good app with one little tweak to make it perfect
body:
Good app to organize your non-essentials. I mean it’s not a calendar but rather a goal app. 
Intuitive and easy to use. Could use a function to  add habits for 2, 3, 6, 12 etc. months as well. Like you know- visit your dead relatives grave or donate blood, empty your houses septic tank or go to a barber and so on. Things you do seldom than monthly. Right now the maximum is one month, meaning the habits you insert into the app are the ones you want to repeat monthly.
